subjective.chief_complaint: Chest pain and shortness of breath for 3 days
subjective.history_of_present_illness: 55-year-old female presenting with persistent chest pain that began 3 days ago while working at her desk. Denies fever or cough. Patient reports high stress at work and poor sleep quality (5 hours per night). Patient expresses significant concern about possible myocardial infarction.

Initial cardiac workup (ECG, troponin) reassuring but cannot exclude acute coronary syndrome or vasospastic angina. Patient has significant family history (father MI age 65) and multiple cardiac risk factors. Plan includes aspirin, cardiology referral for stress testing this week, and close follow-up.
